tips.text: Walk up and hit with the edge of Decimate at its outer ring. The inner handle does less damage and adds no Hemorrhage stack.
Hit the enemy champion with Decimate's edge whenever you can. It heals you more for each champion the edge hits.
Use Crippling Strike on your next attack when the enemy tries to walk away. It leaves them slowed so you can keep hitting.
Use Apprehend to drag an enemy who is backing off into your range. It pulls them in and knocks them up, so follow with attacks.
Don't try to move or cast Decimate right after Apprehend. Darius is stuck for a moment, so aim it carefully.
Build up Hemorrhage stacks with attacks and abilities before you use Noxian Guillotine. It deals the most damage against a fully stacked target.
Recast Noxian Guillotine right away if it kills. At its top rank, a kill resets it fully, so you can keep chaining fights.
Don't use Noxian Guillotine on a target who is rooted or grounded, because Darius can't cast it. Wait until you are free.
Stay in the fight and keep trading. Darius gets stronger the longer it lasts, and he has little to escape with.

combos.name: Crippling Strike animation cancel
combos.when: When you want to trade fast in melee range.
combos.text: Cast Decimate during the Crippling Strike attack animation. The empowered hit still lands and you save time.

combos.name: Decimate edge poke
combos.when: When harassing in lane while the enemy stands at the edge of your range.
combos.text: Hit with the outer edge of Decimate, not the handle. The edge deals full damage, applies a bleed stack, and heals you.

tips.text: Hit enemies with the edge of Decimate, not the close-in handle. Only the edge adds a Hemorrhage stack and heals you.
Use Decimate on large jungle monsters too. Hitting them with the edge heals you, which helps you clear camps without backing.
Attack with Crippling Strike when an enemy tries to run. It leaves them slowed so you can catch them.
Pull enemies in with Apprehend, then follow with Decimate and attacks. You cannot move or cast Decimate for a moment after the pull, so attack first.
Build up Hemorrhage stacks with attacks before you use Noxian Guillotine. More stacks make it hit much harder.
Look for kills with Noxian Guillotine in a skirmish. A kill lets you recast it, so you can chain onto the next weakened enemy.
Take longer fights. Darius gets stronger the more attacks he lands, so don't leave a fight early once you're ahead.
Hold Apprehend until Aatrox commits to a dash or chain, then pull him in and fight while he is slowed.
Hit Aatrox with Decimate on its edge, not the handle, so you get a Hemorrhage stack and heal.
Walk out of The Darkin Blade's sweet spot at the edge of each swing; it is slow and easy to see coming.
Land Crippling Strike when Aatrox tries to leave, so he cannot easily get away.
Save Noxian Guillotine for when Aatrox is low and has taken many Hemorrhage stacks.
Hold Apprehend until Akali steps close or uses her dash. Pulling her in sets up a deadly trade.
Hit her with Crippling Strike when she tries to leave. It slows her heavily so you can keep attacking.
Swing Decimate with her inside the edge, not the handle; the edge adds a Hemorrhage stack and heals you.
Hit Akali with Noxian Guillotine when she is low. It deals true damage, so her escape tools can't save her.
Step away from Twilight Shroud smoke. Swing Decimate into it anyway, since area attacks still hit her inside.
Back off when Akali has Perfect Execution at level 6 and you are low on health.
Hit Ambessa with Apprehend when she dashes in or steps up to trade; the pull stops her slipping away and sets up your Crippling Strike.
Use Decimate from the edge of its range when she walks up, so you hit her with the blade and get the healing.
Hit her with Crippling Strike when she tries to leave; she is slowed and cannot run away easily.
Build up Hemorrhage stacks with attacks before Noxian Guillotine; it hurts far more on a bleeding target and can finish her.
Do not walk into Repudiation after hitting her; she shields up and then slams the ground around her. Step back out of range, then go in again.
Dodge Flash Frost by stepping aside; it is slow, and its stun only lands if the ice bursts on you.
Use Apprehend to pull Anivia in when she is within range, then hit her with Crippling Strike so she cannot get away.
Walk around her Crystallize wall instead of trying to cross it; it lasts only a short time.
When Anivia becomes an egg, hit it to stop her Rebirth. Do not walk off and let her come back with full health.
Leave Glacial Storm quickly; it slows you and hurts more once it is fully formed.
Catch Aurora with Apprehend when she steps up to trade; she is slowed and pulled in, so your attacks and Decimate land easily.
Use Crippling Strike on Aurora when she tries to run or hop away; the slow makes her easy to catch.
Swing Decimate when Aurora is at the edge of its range, and hit her with the blade, not the handle, to heal and stack Hemorrhage.
Look to finish her with Noxian Guillotine once she is low and Hemorrhage is stacked; she is fragile.
Do not walk into her at range; The Weirding and Twofold Hex punish a straight approach. Wait until Aurora has used them, then step in.
Pull Briar with Apprehend when she leaps in on you, then hit her while she is slowed so she cannot get away.
Land Crippling Strike when she is in Blood Frenzy; she cannot choose to walk away, so the slow keeps her in your axe range.
Trade with Decimate at its edge when she walks up; you heal more if you hit her with the blade and not the handle.
Look for the kill with Noxian Guillotine after a few attacks have stacked Hemorrhage on her. She heals back up if you wait too long.
Do not fight her when she can use Chilling Scream fully charged near a wall; the stun can lose you the trade.
Use Apprehend when Camille steps up to trade; it pulls her in, knocks her up and slows her so you can land your attacks.
Swing Decimate at the edge of its range so the blade hits her and the handle does not.
Camille's Tactical Sweep heals her on champions, so stay out of its outer edge, or trade back right after it.
Stack Hemorrhage with attacks and abilities before Noxian Guillotine; the more stacks, the bigger the true damage.
Use Crippling Strike to slow Camille when she tries to leave, and keep hitting her.
Walk out of Rupture's smoke cloud as soon as you see it. The knock up lasts only briefly, but a hit leaves you slowed.
Hook Cho'Gath with Apprehend when he is at the edge of your range, then hit him right away while he is pulled in.
Hit him with Crippling Strike to slow him, so he can't line up Rupture or walk away from your trade.
Trade right after Cho'Gath uses Feral Scream, since he has spent his silence and has to wait for it to come back.
Do not let Cho'Gath eat minions unchallenged; keep pushing him off them so Feast can't make him large and sturdy.
Look to finish him with Noxian Guillotine once he is low and your bleeds are stacked; it deals true damage.
Apprehend does not work on Mundo while his passive is ready; it blocks the pull. Bait the passive out first, or use Decimate and Crippling Strike instead.
Step on the canister Mundo drops after resisting your pull to destroy it, so he cannot heal from it.
Dodge Infected Bonesaw by sidestepping; it is a narrow line and the first enemy it hits stops it, so keep minions between you.
Hold Crippling Strike to slow Mundo when he runs at you, so you can keep hitting him.
Do not hit Mundo too long during Heart Zapper; he stores damage and heals it back. Back off or stay out of range when it ends.
Burst Mundo down fast once he uses Maximum Dosage, because he heals through slow damage.
Hit Fiora with Decimate at its edge, and avoid the handle. The handle does less damage and adds no Hemorrhage.
Do not use Apprehend while Riposte is ready. She can parry the pull and stun you.
Bait out Riposte with a basic attack or Crippling Strike, then pull her once it is on cooldown.
Stay in the fight and keep stacking Hemorrhage. Noxian Guillotine finishes her when her health is low.
Land Apprehend when Gangplank walks up to shoot or place a keg; the pull drags him into your reach.
Hit Gangplank with Decimate's edge at max range, not the handle, to get the full damage and healing.
Use Crippling Strike to slow Gangplank, then stay on him; he struggles to keep range.
Stay out of keg blasts; they slow you and hit hard. You can attack a keg to defuse it safely.
Stack Hemorrhage, then finish with Noxian Guillotine; Remove Scurvy only heals him and cannot stop the true damage.
After level 6, expect Cannon Barrage on you when low; do not flee into it.
Hit Garen with Apprehend as he steps in; pull him into your axe and fight on your terms.
Play around Garen's Decisive Strike; if he hits you, you are silenced and can't use your abilities for a moment.
Swing Decimate from max range to poke Garen, then back off before he reaches you.
Keep hitting Garen so Hemorrhage stacks. Noxian Guillotine does far more damage at full stacks.
Garen's Courage shield makes short trades weak. Wait for it to be used before you commit.
Don't stay in Judgment's spin; leave it quickly or fight when he cannot spin freely.
Use Crippling Strike to slow Garen when he tries to run, and keep trading while he can't leave.
Keep your health up; Demacian Justice finishes you faster the lower you are.
Wait until Gnar's Boomerang Throw is spent, then walk up and hit him; he is easy to catch when his poke is down.
Use Apprehend to pull Gnar in when he stands at the edge of his range, then follow with Crippling Strike so he stays slowed and cannot kite you.
Swing Decimate so the edge catches Gnar; it stacks Hemorrhage and heals you. The handle does not add a stack.
Fight away from walls when Gnar is Mega; his GNAR! stuns you if it throws you into terrain.
Trade hard right after Gnar turns back to Mini; he cannot gain Rage for a while and is weaker.
Once Hemorrhage is stacked, use Noxian Guillotine to finish a low-health Gnar; kills let you cast it again.
Hit Gragas with Decimate at the edge of its range. The edge deals full damage and the handle deals less.
Walk out of the Barrel Roll area before it goes off. Staying inside lets it slow you.
Pull Gragas in with Apprehend when he is out of position, then trade fast, building Hemorrhage stacks.
Watch for Body Slam when you step forward. Fight him when it is on cooldown and chasing him is not risky.
Do not fight near the enemy tower with Gragas's ultimate ready. Explosive Cask can knock you into danger.
Play around his empowered attack from Drunken Rage; it hurts more the more health you have.
Pull Gwen in with Apprehend when she steps up to hit a minion, then trade with Decimate and your attacks while she is slowed.
Hit Gwen with the edge of Decimate at its far reach, not the handle. The edge adds a Hemorrhage stack and heals you.
Do not chase Gwen inside her Hallowed Mist. She cannot be targeted from outside it, so wait for it to end or back off.
Use Crippling Strike to slow Gwen when she tries to leave, so you can catch her.
Fight when Gwen has used Hallowed Mist. Stack Hemorrhage, then finish with Noxian Guillotine at level 6.
Walk up when Heimerdinger's grenade is on cooldown, because he cannot stun you then.
Use Apprehend to pull Heimerdinger away from his turrets, then fight him there.
Take down all his turrets together with the help of minions instead of one at a time.
Use Crippling Strike to slow him once you are close, so he cannot walk away.
Wait for his ultimate to be down before going for the kill; he has little left to escape you.
Use Decimate on him from the edge of its range to heal and build Hemorrhage.
Pull Illaoi off her Tentacles with Apprehend, then fight her away from the terrain where they spawn.
Hit Illaoi with Crippling Strike when she steps in; the slow stops her from escaping and keeps her in your Decimate.
Hit her with the edge of Decimate at its outer range, because the handle gives no Hemorrhage stack.
Build up Hemorrhage stacks before Noxian Guillotine; it deals more damage with each stack and can finish her.
Avoid a long fight beside her Tentacles; they heal her when they hit you. Burst her down quickly or back off.
Hit Irelia with Apprehend when she dashes in. Pulling her next to you lets you start your Hemorrhage stacks.
Fight her away from minion waves. Without minions, Bladesurge has fewer targets to dash to.
Don't spend Decimate or Apprehend on Defiant Dance. Wait until she releases, then hit her.
Hit Irelia with Crippling Strike when she dashes in. It slows her, so she cannot kite you.
Fight Irelia when her Ionian Fervor stacks are down. She attacks more slowly and hits less hard.
Look for Noxian Guillotine once she is low and you have stacked Hemorrhage. Her escapes are weaker without Bladesurge.
Wait until Counter Strike ends before attacking Jax; his dodge makes your attacks miss, then he stuns you.
Pull Jax in with Apprehend after he uses Counter Strike or Leap Strike, then keep hitting him.
Swing Decimate at the edge of its range so Jax takes the full hit. Heal if he stays in range.
Slow Jax with Crippling Strike when he leaps in, so he can't easily get away or keep attacking.
Stop Jax from attacking in a row; his Attack Speed grows with each hit, so break up his fight with Apprehend and Decimate.
Walk up and hit Jayce with Apprehend when he is in cannon form; the pull and knock up bring him into your axe range, so he can't keep poking.
Stay close once you are on him. Crippling Strike leaves him slowed so he cannot kite you back.
Land Decimate with the edge for healing, and build Hemorrhage stacks before you fight. Five stacks make you hit much harder.
Save Noxian Guillotine for when Jayce is low after stacks have built up. A kill lets you cast it again.
Walk up and hit K'Sante with Decimate from the edge of its range, then step back before he can answer with Ntofo Strikes.
Use Crippling Strike to keep K'Sante slowed when he tries to walk away or reach you. It also makes your next attack hit harder.
Pull K'Sante in with Apprehend when his Path Maker is on cooldown. He can't ram you or stun you with it, so you can trade freely.
Build up Hemorrhage stacks before you use Noxian Guillotine. It deals true damage, so it cuts through his tankiness.
When K'Sante goes All Out, he loses a lot of health and armor. Fight him hard then, because he is much easier to kill.
Pressure Kayle before level 6; she is a weak melee champion and cannot trade well with you.
Hook Kayle with Apprehend when she steps up to last-hit, then fight while she is pulled in and slowed.
Hit Kayle with Decimate at the edge of its range so the blade lands and you heal.
Use Crippling Strike to stay on Kayle when she tries to kite; its heavy slow keeps her close.
Do not use Noxian Guillotine while Kayle is invulnerable from Divine Judgment; wait until it ends.
After Kayle gets range, she is hard to catch, so end the lane early with a lead.
Hit Kennen with Apprehend when he comes in to trade. The pull keeps him in reach so you can hit him.
Keep minions between you and Kennen. Thundering Shuriken stops at the first enemy it hits.
Avoid taking three Mark of the Storm hits in a row. The stun leaves you open to a big trade.
Hit him with Crippling Strike when he tries to leave. The slow makes it hard for him to get away.
Kennen is fragile, so punish him when he gets careless with Lightning Rush. Turn and attack him as it ends.
Hit Kennen with Decimate to heal and build Hemorrhage stacks. Use the edge of the axe, not the handle.
Wait for the end of Slicing Maelstrom before you commit. Fighting him inside it hurts a lot.
Pull Kled in with Apprehend when he walks up to trade, then follow with Crippling Strike so he stays slowed and cannot easily leave.
Hit Kled with the edge of Decimate at its far reach, not the handle. The edge adds a Hemorrhage stack and heals you.
Step out of line or fight near minions when Kled throws Bear Trap on a Rope. If it hooks you, stay close and he will pull you in.
Respect Kled when Violent Tendencies is ready, since his fourth hit hurts. Trade when it is on cooldown.
Once Skaarl runs and Kled is dismounted, press him with Decimate and Noxian Guillotine. He cannot use Jousting or his charge until he remounts.
Build up Hemorrhage stacks with attacks, then finish Kled with Noxian Guillotine. More stacks mean more damage.
Don't stand in Malphite's range for long; Seismic Shard slows you and speeds him up.
Pull Malphite in with Apprehend when you want to fight, then trade fast before his Ground Slam cuts your damage.
Break his Granite Shield with a quick Decimate swing, then stack Hemorrhage while it is down.
Stay out of a Malphite fight when Unstoppable Force is ready; it lands on you whatever you do.
Hook Mordekaiser with Apprehend when he walks up to trade. Then hit him with Crippling Strike so he is slowed.
Use Decimate from the edge of its range to poke him, and avoid staying inside his aura.
Hold your attacks while Indestructible is up. Hit him again after the shield fades.
Do not stand beside Mordekaiser once Darkness Rise is on. Back off and let it run out.
Keep Noxian Guillotine away from Mordekaiser until Realm of Death is used. It cannot be cast inside.
Stay away from the line of Death's Grasp. It drags you into his reach and follows with Obliterate.
Wait for Naafiri to use Eviscerate, then walk up and fight. She is easier to catch while it is on cooldown.
Land Apprehend when she tries to back away. She is pulled in, knocked up and slowed, so you can follow with your attacks.
Swing Decimate when her Packmates and she are all close to you. The blade hits each of them and heals you for each champion hit.
Use Crippling Strike to slow her when she tries to run out of a trade.
Build Hemorrhage stacks on her before you use Noxian Guillotine. It will usually finish her once she is low.
Hit Nasus with Apprehend when he steps up to last-hit, then trade with Decimate and Crippling Strike.
Do not let Nasus land Wither on you; it makes you slowed and weakens your attacks more the longer it lasts. Trade fast or back off.
Punish Nasus early, before Siphoning Strike has grown; deny his last-hits with Decimate from the edge of its range.
Do not fight inside Fury of the Sands; Nasus becomes much sturdier and burns you as you stand near him.
Build Hemorrhage stacks before Noxian Guillotine; it deals more damage the more stacks Nasus has on him.
Use Apprehend to pull Olaf in, but expect him to answer with Ragnarok. Ragnarok cleanses the disable and makes him immune to more.
Step out of the line of Undertow, and don't let Olaf pick the axe up for free. Picking it up cuts the cooldown.
Finish Olaf before he gets low. His Berserker Rage gives him more Attack Speed and Life Steal the lower he gets.
Use Crippling Strike to keep Olaf slowed while Hemorrhage stacks build, so he can't easily walk away from the trade.
Swing Decimate when Olaf is in range to heal back some of the damage you took.
Pull Ornn in with Apprehend when he walks up to trade, then hit him with Decimate and your attacks while he is slowed.
Stay out of a straight line with a wall behind you. Searing Charge into terrain knocks you up and stuns you.
Sidestep Volcanic Rupture. It slows you, and the pillar at its end blocks your path.
Land Crippling Strike on Ornn when he tries to leave. It slows him heavily, so you can catch him.
Don't try to stop Bellows Breath with crowd control. Ornn moves through it, so stay clear of the cone.
Build Hemorrhage stacks on Ornn before level 6. Noxian Guillotine then hits very hard, and a kill lets you cast it again.
Pull Pantheon in with Apprehend when he lands from Shield Vault. It leaves him slowed and in your range.
Don't swing Decimate or attack into Aegis Assault from the front. Walk around to his side or back, or wait for it to end.
Use Crippling Strike to slow Pantheon when he tries to leave, then chase and stack Hemorrhage.
Stay healthy against Pantheon. When your health is low, a thrown Comet Spear hurts much more.
When Pantheon uses Grand Starfall, he is gone for a few seconds. Push the wave or reposition, and don't stand in the target area.
Pull Quinn in with Apprehend when she vaults away or tries to kite, then follow with Crippling Strike so she stays slowed and cannot walk out.
Swing Decimate when Quinn is in range to poke her. Hit her with the edge, not the handle, so you heal and add a Hemorrhage stack.
Look for the kill with Noxian Guillotine once Quinn has several Hemorrhage stacks. Quinn is fragile, so it hits very hard.
Quinn is weaker in a long, close fight. Push your lead and trade when Vault is on cooldown, so she cannot bounce away.
Land Apprehend when Renekton dashes in or tries to leave; the pull and slow set up your stacks.
Respect Ruthless Predator when his Fury is high; it stuns for much longer, so keep your distance then.
Use Decimate when he walks into range, hitting with the blade rather than the handle for full damage and healing.
Use Crippling Strike to slow Renekton after he dashes in, so he can't easily escape.
Harass Renekton when he can't fight back; keeping his Fury low makes his abilities much weaker.
Finish him with Noxian Guillotine once he has many bleeds on him; it deals more damage with each stack.
Aim Apprehend at Riven when she dashes in. Pulling her out of her combo leaves her short on escapes.
Swing Decimate at the edge of its reach so the blade hits her and not the handle. Hit her with it when she steps in to trade.
Respect Ki Burst: when she's close, you can be stunned and eat a full combo. Stay a step out of range until she spends it.
Use Crippling Strike to slow her when she tries to dash out, then chase her down.
Look for a longer fight. Hemorrhage stacks build, and Riven has little defense or healing, so you win if she can't leave.
Finish her with Noxian Guillotine when she is low and fully bled.
Walk up when Electro Harpoon is spent. Rumble has little to stop you then, and you can land Apprehend.
Pull Rumble with Apprehend, then use Decimate and your attacks. He has few ways to escape once you close in.
Hit Rumble with the edge of Decimate, not the handle. Only the edge adds a Hemorrhage stack and heals you.
Attack Rumble while he's overheating and can't cast. Crippling Strike slows him so he can't get away.
Leave The Equalizer's trail as soon as you see the rockets drop. Standing in it costs you a lot of health.
Hit Sett with Decimate at its edge, not the handle, so you get a Hemorrhage stack and heal. Step in close enough to reach him with the blade.
Pull Sett in with Apprehend when he tries to walk away or trade, then keep hitting him while he is slowed.
Land Crippling Strike when Sett tries to back off or run at you, so he is slowed and you stay on him.
Sett's Haymaker turns damage he has taken into a shield. Trade in short bursts so he cannot bank much damage, and fight again once it has faded.
Save Noxian Guillotine until you have built Hemorrhage stacks on Sett, so it hits much harder. Use it to finish him once he is low.
Land Apprehend when Shen walks up to last-hit, then follow with Crippling Strike and Decimate. He has few ways to escape the pull.
Do not hit Shen while Spirit's Refuge is up. It blocks your basic attacks, so wait for it to end or back off.
Stay out of Shadow Dash's line. If you are taunted, you will walk into Shen and his empowered attacks.
Hit Shen with Decimate from the edge of its range. His Twilight Assault empowered attacks hurt, so do not stand beside him.
After level 6, expect Shen to teleport in with Stand United to save an ally. Do not chase far from your side of the lane.
Hook Singed with Apprehend as he runs by, so he cannot kite you and you can fight him up close.
Do not stand in his Poison Trail; fight from outside it or step out of it.
Avoid standing in Mega Adhesive when Singed is near. If he Flings you into it, you are rooted.
Use Crippling Strike to slow Singed when he flees, then finish him with Noxian Guillotine once he has several bleeds.
Swing Decimate when Singed is close to heal back poison damage.
Walk out of the way of a charging Decimating Smash instead of standing in it. If Sion releases it early, it is weaker and doesn't stun.
Pull Sion in with Apprehend while he charges Decimating Smash. It is a good way to catch him if he has stayed in place.
Use Decimate at the edge of its range to poke Sion when his Roar of the Slayer is on cooldown. It also heals you.
Hit Sion with Crippling Strike to slow him hard, then stack bleeds. A slowed Sion has trouble getting away or lining up his charge.
When Sion's shield from Soul Furnace is up, wait before you go in. Its recast explosion hurts, so fight when it is gone or he has used it.
Don't finish Sion with Noxian Guillotine and then stay close. He returns with Glory in Death, so back away from him until it ends.
Walk up and use Decimate when Tahm Kench is in range; the edge hit heals you and puts a Hemorrhage stack on him.
Hit Tahm Kench with Crippling Strike when he tries to leave, so he stays slowed and you can keep fighting.
Pull him in with Apprehend so you can stack Hemorrhage and trade while his Tongue Lash is on cooldown.
Hit him with Noxian Guillotine once he has many Hemorrhage stacks, because it hurts more with each stack.
Don't fight right after Tahm Kench has taken a lot of damage and then waited. Thick Skin heals him back up when he is left alone.
Walk up to Teemo and use Apprehend to pull him in. He can't kite you once he is knocked up.
Land Crippling Strike on Teemo when you close in. It slows him heavily so he can't walk away.
Check bushes before walking in, as Teemo can hide there unseen. Mushrooms are hard to spot, so don't chase him through unknown ground.
Hit a mushroom with basic attacks to destroy it before it goes off. It has very little health.
Hit Teemo with Decimate from the edge of its range. The blade deals full damage and you heal when it hits.
Use Decimate from the edge of its range to hit Darius hard and heal; don't stand at the handle, which hits weaker.
Pull Tryndamere in with Apprehend when he tries to dash away, then follow with Crippling Strike so he stays slowed.
Don't use Noxian Guillotine to finish Tryndamere while Undying Rage is active; he can't be killed. Wait until it ends.
Harass Tryndamere early so he can't gain Fury from last-hits and heal with Bloodlust.
Chase Tryndamere with care; Mocking Shout slows you when you face away and cuts your damage.
Once Urgot's Disdain is spent, step in and trade, because he has lost his stun and his shield.
Use Apprehend to pull Urgot in when he stands at range with Corrosive Charge. Then fight him up close.
Use Crippling Strike to slow Urgot when he walks away firing Purge, so you can stay on him.
Build up Hemorrhage stacks on Urgot, then finish him with Noxian Guillotine when he is low.
Side-step Corrosive Charge by moving away from where it lands. It explodes after a short delay.
Catch Varus with Apprehend when he charges Piercing Arrow; the pull knocks him up and brings him into your reach.
Use Crippling Strike on Varus to slow him heavily so he cannot kite away.
Walk through minions toward Varus, and dodge Hail of Arrows by not standing in the marked ground.
Be wary of Chain of Corruption; once rooted, Varus's arrows hurt. Run far from the tendril to break it.
Use Decimate to heal when Varus is within reach, and press your lead once he has used his skills.
Hit Vayne with Apprehend to pull her in; she is fragile and cannot trade well up close.
Swing Decimate at max range to poke her, but expect Tumble to dodge it if she sees it coming.
Do not fight with a wall behind you; Condemn pins you there for a stun and heavy damage.
Use Crippling Strike to slow her when she tries to back away, then stay on her to stack bleeds.
Wait out Condemn before you go in; when it is on cooldown, you can walk onto her.
Finish her with Noxian Guillotine once she has a few bleeds on her; it deals more damage with each one.
Walk up and hit Vladimir with Apprehend when Sanguine Pool is on cooldown. He can't escape you then.
Don't chase Vladimir into his Sanguine Pool. He is untargetable inside it and you will be slowed.
Use Decimate on Vladimir at the edge of its range, since the blade hits harder than the handle. It also heals you.
Stack Hemorrhage with attacks before Noxian Guillotine. The more stacks, the more damage it does to Vladimir.
Kill Vladimir before Hemoplague bursts. It heals him if it hits you, and you take extra damage while it is on you.
Hit Volibear with Decimate from the edge of its range, and avoid standing next to him when he has Thundering Smash up.
Pull Volibear in with Apprehend when he runs at you with Thundering Smash. If it knocks him up first, his stun is wasted.
Step out of the Sky Splitter circle once you see Volibear cast it. It lands after a delay.
Use Crippling Strike to slow Volibear when he tries to leave or to chase.
Build up Hemorrhage stacks before Noxian Guillotine. Volibear's Frenzied Maul heals him in a long fight, so finish him quickly.
Hit Xin Zhao with Apprehend when he tries to start a fight. Pulling him in stops him from picking the moment of the trade.
Use Crippling Strike on him when he charges in. It slows him heavily so he can't finish his combo.
Swing Decimate when he stands next to you so you heal. Aim to hit him with the edge of the axe, not the handle.
Stack Hemorrhage on him before you use Noxian Guillotine. It deals much more damage the more stacks he has.
Hit Yasuo with Decimate from the edge of its range; the handle does less damage and adds no Hemorrhage stack.
Use Apprehend to pull Yasuo in, then hit him with Crippling Strike so he stays slowed and cannot easily walk away.
Yasuo's Wind Wall blocks projectiles, but Apprehend is not blocked by it, so pull him through the wall.
Look for Noxian Guillotine once Hemorrhage is stacked high; it hits harder with each stack and can finish a fleeing Yasuo.
Use Apprehend when Yone steps in to trade; it pulls him onto you, knocks him up and slows him, so you can start your Hemorrhage stacks.
Swing Decimate when Yone is at the edge of its range. It hits for full damage and heals you.
Hit Yone with Crippling Strike when he tries to run away or reset. It slows him heavily so you can follow up.
Keep Yone on five Hemorrhage stacks, then finish him with Noxian Guillotine. It hurts most against a target with many stacks.
Yone's Soul Unbound gives him speed and escape, so save Apprehend to catch him when he uses it.
Hit Yorick with Apprehend when his Dark Procession is on cooldown; he has no easy way to block you then.
Break Dark Procession by attacking it, or walk around it, rather than waiting it out.
Kill Mist Walkers with a basic attack before you fight Yorick; each one dies to a single hit.
Swing Decimate at long range to poke Yorick, and keep him off his graves.
Build Hemorrhage stacks, then finish with Noxian Guillotine before Yorick heals back up with Last Rites.
Hit Zaahen with Decimate from the edge of its range so the handle does not waste the blade's Hemorrhage stack.
Use Apprehend when Zaahen dashes in or tries to walk away; it pulls him back and slows him.
Do not rely on Noxian Guillotine to finish Zaahen when his stacks are full; he can revive instead of dying.
Keep Crippling Strike ready to slow Zaahen when he tries to trade, so you can stay on him.
Step out of line with Dreaded Return so it does not catch you, and punish him while it is on cooldown.
Hit Graves with Apprehend to pull him in. Then fight up close, where he cannot kite you.
Landing Crippling Strike slows Graves heavily. Follow up with Decimate to stack Hemorrhage and heal.
Leave the Smoke Screen cloud right away. Its slow ends as soon as you step out.
Graves has few ways to get out of a fight once you are on him. Press your lead and finish with Noxian Guillotine.
Watch for Quickdraw. Once Graves has used it, he has fewer escapes, so commit to the fight.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard. Dragon Strike knocks up anyone in that path.
Pull Jarvan in with Apprehend when he comes close, then swing Decimate. Stacking Hemorrhage fast wins you the fight.
Hit Jarvan with Crippling Strike to slow him when he tries to run or dive. It is hard for him to leave after that.
Inside a Cataclysm ring you can still use Apprehend and Noxian Guillotine. Jarvan is trapped with you, so go all in if you have the health.
Hit Kayn with Apprehend when he fights near you; it pulls him in and knocks him up, so you can keep hitting him.
Hit Kayn with Crippling Strike when he tries to run; the slow makes it hard for him to get away.
Build up Hemorrhage stacks with attacks before you use Noxian Guillotine on Kayn. More stacks make it hit much harder.
Use Decimate when Kayn stands close to you. It heals you for each enemy champion it hits with the edge.
Stay in a long fight if you can. Darius gets stronger the longer it lasts, and Kayn's burst is strongest at the start.
Keep Apprehend for when Kha'Zix jumps in or tries to leave. Pulling him back stops his escape.
Stay near your minions, allies or turret. Kha'Zix's Taste Their Fear hurts far more when you are isolated.
After Kha'Zix uses Leap and Void Assault, he is exposed. Press your lead and chase him down.
Land Crippling Strike when Kha'Zix tries to run. It slows him heavily and keeps him in reach of your attacks.
Hit Kha'Zix with Decimate's edge, not the handle. The edge gives you a Hemorrhage stack and heals you.
Hit Kindred with Apprehend when she is out of position; it pulls her to you and slows her, so she can't kite away.
Land Crippling Strike on Kindred when she tries to run. The heavy slow keeps her in range for your follow-up hits.
Kindred is fragile, so stack Hemorrhage on her with Decimate and basic attacks, then finish with Noxian Guillotine.
Don't fight inside Lamb's Respite. Nobody can die in it, so wait for it to end before you commit to a kill.
Fight Kindred away from Wolf's Frenzy. Wolf's bites and her faster Dance of Arrows cooldown make the fight worse for you inside it.
Hit Lee Sin with Apprehend when he dashes in with Resonating Strike. It pulls him to you and stops him fighting at his own range.
Stack Hemorrhage on Lee Sin with attacks and Decimate, then finish him with Noxian Guillotine when he is low.
Stay away from walls and teammates when Lee Sin is near. Dragon's Rage knocks you back and hurts anyone you hit.
Lee Sin slows you with Tempest when you chase him. Hit him with Crippling Strike to slow him back and keep him in the fight.
Build up Hemorrhage stacks on Master Yi and then use Noxian Guillotine. It finishes him before he can run away.
Hit Master Yi with Apprehend as he jumps in or tries to run. Highlander does not stop the pull, so he cannot just walk away.
Do not hit Master Yi with Crippling Strike when Highlander is active. He ignores the slow.
Hit Master Yi a few times so he has to spend mana on Meditate to heal. Cast Decimate when he is not untargetable.
Master Yi is untargetable during Alpha Strike, so do not waste Apprehend or Noxian Guillotine on him while he is mid-jump.
Hit Naafiri with Apprehend when she dashes in or tries to leave; it pulls her to you and slows her, so she cannot simply run off.
Swing Decimate when her Packmates and she are all next to you; it hits everything around you and heals you for each champion hit.
Hit Naafiri with Crippling Strike when she tries to run; the slow lets you catch her and finish her off.
Stack Hemorrhage with attacks before you use Noxian Guillotine on her; it deals more damage with more stacks, and a kill lets you cast it again.
Fight Naafiri in a drawn-out brawl rather than a quick trade. Darius gets stronger the longer a fight lasts, while she wants a fast burst.
Bait out Shroud of Darkness before you throw Apprehend; wait for the shield to fade.
Do not use Noxian Guillotine while Shroud of Darkness is up; it will be blocked.
Stay close to Nocturne with Crippling Strike so he can't run, and fight where you stack bleeds.
Break Unspeakable Horror's tether by moving out of range or using a dash before it ends, so you are not feared.
When the map goes dark from Paranoia, stay near allies; Nocturne can then jump on you.
Pull Shyvana in with Apprehend when she is low on Dragon Fury. She has no ultimate to answer you with.
Hit Shyvana with Decimate from the edge of its range. Stay out of the close handle zone, where it deals little damage.
Wait out Inferno Aegis before you commit. Her shield and speed boost fade quickly, and then she is easy to catch.
Use Crippling Strike when she turns to run. Its heavy slow keeps her close for the rest of your combo.
Don't chase her into Dragon Form with low health. Her Dragon's Descent makes her much tankier and her fire hurts.
Hook Skarner with Apprehend when he comes at you, then fight him while he is slowed.
Stay away from walls when Skarner charges; if he drags you into one, you take damage and are stunned.
Use Crippling Strike to stop Skarner from running away after a trade.
Decimate heals you for each enemy champion it hits with the edge, so use it when Skarner is in range during a fight.
Move out of the way of Impale or you will be suppressed and dragged away.
Pull Sylas in with Apprehend when he dashes close, then hit him with Crippling Strike so he stays slowed and can't leave.
Keep hitting Sylas to build Hemorrhage before you use Noxian Guillotine; the damage grows with each stack.
Swing Decimate when Sylas is close to you; it heals you and adds a Hemorrhage stack when the edge hits him.
Fight Sylas when he can't steal your ultimate, and don't count on a long fight while Kingslayer is ready to heal him.
Hold Apprehend until Talon jumps on you or tries to escape. Pulling him back makes it hard for him to get away.
Fight Talon in a long trade. Decimate heals you, and you are stronger the longer the fight goes.
Use Crippling Strike on Talon when he tries to run. It slows him heavily.
Save Noxian Guillotine for when Talon is low. He is a burst champion, so he is weak when his abilities are on cooldown, and you can finish him.
Watch for Talon to go invisible with Shadow Assault. Expect a second hit from the blades when it ends.
Pull Viego in with Apprehend when he winds up on a wraith or tries to run; he is slowed and knocked up while you close in.
Hit Viego with Crippling Strike when he tries to leave a fight; the slow is heavy and lets you catch him.
Build up Hemorrhage with attacks and Decimate before Noxian Guillotine; the more stacks, the harder it hits.
Save Noxian Guillotine to finish Viego when he is low; if it kills, you can cast it again.
Hit Viego with the edge of Decimate, not the handle, so you heal and add a Hemorrhage stack.
Land Apprehend when Xin Zhao charges in or tries to leave. It pulls him back and breaks his rhythm.
Hit Xin Zhao with Crippling Strike so he is slowed heavily and can't run to chain his Three Talon Strike attacks.
Swing Decimate when he stands in the edge range, not the handle. It heals you and stacks Hemorrhage.
Don't use Noxian Guillotine right after he casts Crescent Guard; it's wasted if you can't get close to finish him.
